en: Stonetalon Supply Run
Collect $1oa Stonetalon Supplies from Pridewing Wyverns and deliver them to Innkeeper Faralia.

<The unfortunate body here bears the marks of many strikes from the Pridewing wyverns. The pack nearby is rumpled and discarded, with its contents missing, and only a small note clutched in the courier's hand to indicate what was lost: a shipment meant for Innkeeper Faralia at Stonetalon Peak.>

<The wyverns have probably carried off the supply bundles to line their nests.>
Bloodfury Trinkets
Bring $1oa Glittering Sunstones to Mor'rogal.

In addition to spreading their filth across the Charred Vale, the Bloodfury harpies gather anything shiny that they can find. I'm told that they collect a variety of golden-yellow sunstones for decoration. I have no use for such trinkets, but Mor'rogal has mentioned using them before.

While you're fighting the harpies of the Vale, keep your eye out for Glittering Sunstones. Bring any that you find to Mor'rogal, up on the hills above us.
Banner of the Fallen
Raise the standard of Ironforge, call out the trogg Headsplitter and kill it, then report to Captain Rugelfuss.

The fallen mountaineer bears a standard of Ironforge. Perhaps she was scouting, or making a doomed charge. Either way, the standard has been cast down and trampled. The mountaineer was hit on the head so hard that her helm was knocked off and she was killed outright by a trogg, likely with a spiked club.

The trogg that killed her is probably still nearby, and likely remembers the banner. Raising the banner of Ironforge once more may call it out.
That banner looks like it's been in a war!

You found Ylva's body? Ah, the poor woman. She said she was going to show the troggs that Ironforge would never fall to their kind. She went looking for a few mountaineers who never returned from a patrol through trogg country. She was always too independent-minded to be cautious. Now we know what happened.

I'll take the banner back and make sure it's cleaned up and displayed. You should take her weapon. May it serve you well against the troggs.
Excavation Tools
Return $1oa Excavation Tools to Magmar Fellhew.
The excavation's tools, left behind when the dwarves fled from the troggs, seem mostly untouched. Returning them to the excavators will surely aid their work.
Silver of the Waves
Return the Monogrammed Silver Hair clip to its owner.
<Among the fishing knickknacks in the debris are some rusty hooks, broken spools of wire, and a slightly corroded but ornate silver hair clip with the monogram "K.D.">
I have a lot of chores today, so can you keep it quick?

My hair clip! I thought this was lost for good!

This'll shine right up with just a little work. Thank you for bringing it to me! I'll make it worth your while.
Snowbound
Deliver a Jar of Snow to Norric Lochthane at his house on the northwest coast of the Loch.

My old mentor, Norric, sent a minor elemental with an odd request. He needs a jar of snow for some of his shamanic workings! I don't know what he's going to do with that, but I learned a long time ago not to question his ways with respect to magic.

I'm busy learning about the local elementals, so I can't leave to help him. Go to the tunnel entrance at South Gate Pass where there's snow year-round. Scoop some up in this ceramic jar and bring it to him before it melts. The jar should keep it cold.
Eh? What do you want?

This jar is for me?

Snow! Grenhild did it! She sent the snow that I asked for!

A pity, though, I was hoping she would come and visit in person.

Well, regardless, thank you for your effort. This is a real help for my work.
Slowing the Orc Advance
Bring $1oa Jagged Orc Swords and $2oa Curved Orc Daggers to Shandrina.

Orcs have taken over the eastern forest, and their scouts and grunts now lurk throughout the woods! It's not safe for our kind to move about Ashenvale any more.

We need to push back the orcs and secure the forest. We've been able to pick off some of the grunts and scouts by carefully sneaking around the edges of their camp.

Fight the orcs and bring me the jagged swords and curved knives that they use. I'll make sure their weapons are salvaged and repurposed, so nothing goes to waste.
Twisting the Knife
Find and defeat the crocolisk Daggerfang and bring back Marek's knife.

Did I ever tell you how I almost lost me hand to a crocolisk? Managed to jam me knife into its jaw, and scrambled out real quick. I thought I had the knife around here somewhere, but I can't seem to find it.

Anyway, that croc is probably still out there hunting along the edge of the lake. That nasty brute probably needs to go, for the safety of the other hunters, if nothing else.

I've taken to calling it Daggerfang. If you see it, give it a friendly hello from me! And by "hello" I mean "stab."
How goes the huntin'?

Hah! You did it! I never thought that ol' croc would get its comeuppance, but that does the trick!

Oh ah... y'know, I had to get me another knife, but maybe that one will bring you some good luck. Why don't you hang onto it?
Ingredients for the Forge
Bring $1oa Bronze Bars to Morhan Coppertongue.

Thelsamar's a great place to live, but we don't have all of the amenities of Ironforge. I'm always running out of bronze! I need more bronze if I'm going to keep making tools and kettles and pots!

I can tell you have a little experience at the forge. Think you could smelt me some bronze bars? I can pay you well for it!
Gotta keep the forges going!
Ah, this is a relief! I should be able to keep the forge going now. Hopefully one of these days we'll get a trader bringing coal into town regularly!
Sticks and Bones
Collect $1oa Dry Branches and bring them to Eleanor Shackleton.

My associate Eleanor Shackleton prides herself on traveling the wilds, surviving against weather and monsters. She is currently camped not far from here, in the hills to the west, and I remember a piece of advice that she once gave me: "When you think you have enough firewood, gather five times more."

If you have some spare time, you could collect some wood in this basket and take it to her camp. I'm sure she could give you a few tips about the existence of a traveling adventurer.
Welcome to my fire, traveler.

Extra firewood? That is always welcome. It will keep these old bones warm through the cold nights of the Glades.

I have a sling for collecting wood myself, so you might as well hang onto that basket.
